mathcounts-potw-2026-10-19-01.title: Effect on the mean
mathcounts-potw-2026-10-19-01.body:
The 8 remaining pumpkins are each 3 lb below the old mean, a total of 24 lb below. So the removed pumpkin is 24 lb above the old mean: $16 + 24 = 40$.

**Answer: 40 pounds**

mathcounts-potw-2026-10-19-02.title: Cross off ends
mathcounts-potw-2026-10-19-02.body:
Cross off smallest and largest repeatedly: 8 & 18, 11 & 15, 12 & 14; left with 12 and 14, average 13.

**Answer: 13 pounds**

mathcounts-potw-2026-10-19-04.title: Solve the mean equation
mathcounts-potw-2026-10-19-04.body:
$\frac{P + x}{2} = M$, so $P + x = 2M$ and $x = 2M - P$.

**Answer: $2M - P$**

mathcounts-potw-2026-10-19-04.title: Total minus known
mathcounts-potw-2026-10-19-04.body:
Two pumpkins with mean $M$ weigh $2M$ in total; take away the first: $2M - P$.

**Answer: $2M - P$**
